sn34.50:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ: cattārome bhikkhave, jhāyī. katame cattāro: idha bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī neva samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo. idha pana bhikkhave, ekacco jhāyī samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca. tatra bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī …pe… pavaro cāti. 13. 1. 42. ārammaṇa abhinīhāra suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: cattārome bhikkhave, jhāyī. katame cattāro …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe… pavaro cāti. 13. 1. 43. ārammaṇa sakkaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 44. ārammaṇa sātaccakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sātaccakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 45. ārammaṇa sappāyakārī suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sappāyakārī …pe…. 13. 1. 46. gocara abhinīhāra suttaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ: …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe…
sn34.50:1.2: samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo
sn34.50:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo …pe… samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca hoti,
